scripts.human:build: pnpm --filter @getauthui/core build && echo '\nBuild complete. Sync pins if you bumped the version (pnpm sync:cdn-pins), then: pnpm human:publish'
scripts.human:publish: pnpm human:build && pnpm --filter @getauthui/core exec npm publish --access public && echo '\nPublished @getauthui/core. Commit any pin sync, push origin/main, then: pnpm docs:deploy'
scripts.agent:publish-pre: BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) && pnpm --filter @getauthui/core exec npm version prerelease --preid=$BRANCH --no-git-tag-version && pnpm sync:cdn-pins && pnpm --filter @getauthui/core build && pnpm --filter @getauthui/core exec npm publish --access public --tag $BRANCH && echo '\nPrerelease published. Commit version + pin sync, push, then: pnpm docs:deploy'
scripts.agent:publish-patch: pnpm --filter @getauthui/core exec npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && pnpm sync:cdn-pins && pnpm --filter @getauthui/core build && pnpm --filter @getauthui/core exec npm publish --access public && echo '\nPatch published. Commit version + pin sync, push origin/main, then: pnpm docs:deploy'
scripts.agent:publish-minor: pnpm --filter @getauthui/core exec npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && pnpm sync:cdn-pins && pnpm --filter @getauthui/core build && pnpm --filter @getauthui/core exec npm publish --access public && echo '\nMinor published. Commit version + pin sync, push origin/main, then: pnpm docs:deploy'
scripts.docs:deploy: appwrite client --endpoint https://fra.cloud.appwrite.io/v1 --project-id 6aafa421001e80b7153a && appwrite sites create-deployment --site-id authui-docs --code . --activate -f
